title: LuckRead API Operation Policy
description: Machine-readable binding between public API operations and authorization/concurrency/idempotency/audit policy. This contract complements OpenAPI without embedding product authorization logic in a generated framework schema.

x-luckread.single-source-rule: Every OpenAPI operationId MUST appear exactly once in operations.

operations.x-luckread-authentication: Public provider callback ingress authenticated by W07 HMAC-SHA512 verification over exact raw request bytes; no browser session
operations.x-luckread-idempotency: provider + merchant_id + event_id + payload SHA-256; enforced by the unique D1-04 webhook receipt identity and immutable payload-conflict record, not by an HTTP Idempotency-Key header

operations.x-luckread-authentication: Public provider callback. W07 always compares the configured dashboard Authorization value in constant time; when HMAC is enabled, it verifies X-RevenueCat-Webhook-Signature HMAC-SHA256 over the exact raw bytes.
operations.x-luckread-idempotency: app_id + event.id + raw payload SHA-256; same payload is an idempotent duplicate, changed payload is retained separately as a durable conflict.
